The estimated single-cycle floor for the 8-instruction armed/non-outlier path at 240 MHz is about 33 ns, but cache and interrupt effects cannot be established offline. Silicon runtime observer effect is therefore NOT claimed accepted; the bounded live proposal includes matched trace-off/trace-on p99 windows and uses traceWriteCycles for outlier append cost.
